name: Wishful pricing settings
description: Configure pricing for this discount (one table per discount).
title: Size × quantity pricing
introVolume: Unit price by quantity break only — no width, height, or sq in.
saveError: Could not save pricing settings. Try again.
intro: Set which products use this rate table, then configure tiers and save.
discountScopeHint: One pricing type per discount. Nametags (volume) and stickers (size × qty) need two separate discounts with Combinations enabled for mixed carts.
productsHelp: Only these products get this discount’s calculated price. The picker replaces the full list.
productsMultiDiscount: Use a separate discount for each product type (e.g. nametags vs stickers). Enable Combinations on both: Product discount + Product discount (different items).
allProductsHint: No products selected — this discount will not apply to any product until you choose products and save.
areaFlatModeHint: Customer enters width and height. Price is a flat amount per piece for that size band — no quantity discounts.
matrixHelpAreaFlat: One price per row: total sq in (W×H) picks the band; multiply by cart quantity at checkout.
volumeModeHint: No width or height needed. Set unit price for each quantity break; checkout uses cart quantity only.
volumeMatrixHelp: Unit price ($) for each quantity break. Set a row per variant (size, backing, etc.).
variantRatesFallback: Default prices (used if a variant has no row yet)
areaHelp: Each row is a size band. First band: leave Min empty, set Max (e.g. less than 20). Middle bands: Min and Max (e.g. 20–40). Last band: set Max to your limit.
qtyHelp: Each break starts at Min quantity (e.g. 1, 25, 100). Label is shown on the product page table.
qtyHelpVolume: Each break is a min cart quantity (e.g. 1, 25, 100). Labels appear in the unit-price table below.
matrixHelp: One price per cell: area row × quantity column.
modifiersHelp: Checkbox options that add or subtract from the unit price for products assigned to this discount. Each uses a line item property key on the product page and applies at checkout for those lines only.
modifierAmountLabel: Amount per unit (use negative to discount)
tierHint: After changing thresholds or breaks, fill in any new rate cells. Save to apply at checkout.
volumeTierHint: Set a unit price for each quantity break, then save.
saveButtonHint: Or use Save at the top of the page when it appears. Storefront tables sync to chosen products automatically.
refreshStorefrontHint: Run after deleting a discount or removing products — rebuilds the shop catalog from saved active discounts only (not the form) and removes leftover product metafields.
storefrontSyncRefreshed: Storefront updated. Catalog has {{catalogKeys}} product(s). Removed {{cleared}} stale entries.
storefrontSyncOk: Synced {{count}} product(s). Catalog has {{catalogKeys}} product(s). Removed {{cleared}} stale storefront entries.
storefrontSyncCleared: Storefront catalog cleared ({{cleared}} stale product metafield(s) removed). Wishful UI will hide on products no longer in any discount.
storefrontSyncCatalogMissing: Shop catalog did not save. Run shopify app deploy, then Save pricing again. In admin check Settings → Custom data → Shop → Wishful pricing catalog.
storefrontSyncNone: Choose products so the theme can show live prices (metafield sync).
accountPricingHelp: Percent off the retail rate table above for logged-in customers who match a tier key. Same discount applies to every product in this discount.
accountPricingMetafieldHint: Tier key must match (case-insensitive): customer tag wholesale, metafield wishful.account_tier, or B2B company:123456789. Save pricing after changes. Customer must visit the product page while logged in so the tier syncs to cart at checkout.
